summary: P01 V2.47.237 fixes large Navigation taxonomy selection and sorting UX. Resource add/edit now uses a bounded searchable category picker ordered exactly like the canonical Repository category tree (sort_order DESC, legacy_position ASC, id ASC, then tree preorder), with parent-path context for child categories. Category sorting now opens in a dedicated modal instead of replacing the narrow sidebar, while continuing to use the existing complete active-category management projection and canonical category_reorder persistence. No Schema/Migration, no Category mutation semantic change, no auth/session/security semantic change, no updater mechanism change. Production remains Owner-manual.
